name: CaseAntdFocusOutlineRing
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "antd-focus-outline-ring" (interaction-states). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: button.root:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(145, 202, 255); outline-offset: 1px } — the focus ring as an OUTLINE state delta on the ROOT (antd Button, Switch)
